opening.argument: The opportunity is built around paid packages, tokens, mining-pool participation, and rewards tied to growing a team. Participants would usually pay for their packs, then enter the mining pool with their tokens; the speaker also says six tokens are needed to produce a ready-made OneCoin. The matching-bonus presentation shows members earning when they help others earn, with rewards extending across four generations. Access to the One Pay Platform is described as requiring a bank ID, a regular bank account, and an electricity bill. These details present OneCoin as a money-making opportunity centered on paid mining and team-based returns. They do not establish that anyone submitted documents, completed a transaction, suffered a loss, or received a return.
